agent.reasons: Beneficial ownership is incomplete. 30% of the shares belong to no one identified, and Granite Holdings LLC holds 44% but its owners are unknown. Either gap could hide an individual owning 25% or more, so 3.3 requires requesting documents. The other checks passed: the control person is identified (CEO Mateo Weiss), his ID is verified, there are no sanctions, PEP or adverse media hits, the industry is normal, the country is the US, and the registry filing from 2026-01-15 is less than 12 months old. None of these calls for a more severe outcome.
